# Accessibility Standards

This directory contains standards for ensuring applications meet accessibility requirements and comply with WCAG guidelines.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/accessibility/README.md#std-app-acc-001-accessibility]

### STD-APP-ACC-001: Accessibility

Standards for implementing accessible user interfaces, ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.2 Level AA, supporting assistive technologies, and providing inclusive user experiences.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/accessibility/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Compliance with accessibility regulations (ADA, Section 508)
- Support for assistive technologies (screen readers, keyboard navigation)
- Inclusive design for users with diverse abilities
- Consistent accessibility implementation across applications
- Testable and measurable accessibility criteria
